observations: Single rigid solar panel leaning diagonally against an interior wall near a glass door.
Panel has visible monocrystalline half-cut cells in a black frame, consistent with a residential/commercial solar panel.
A faint watermark reading 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' appears across the panel face; this looks like a reseller/photo watermark, not a label on the panel itself.
No visible spec sticker, junction box label, wattage rating, or brand/model markings on the frame or back of the panel.
Only one photo provided, showing a front-angled view; no close-up of corners, back sheet, or junction box.

claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text, not a verifiable factual claim about this specific panel's condition or specs.

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating unknown — price of solar panels varies drastically by wattage tier (e.g. 330W vs 450W vs 550W+).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear spec sticker or the panel's rated power label.
risks.if_unproven: cannot even be bucketed into a worst-case price tier without this

risks.risk: Physical condition (microcracks, hotspots, broken cells, frame damage) cannot be judged from a single angled photo with glare.
risks.proof: Straight-on, well-lit photo of the full panel face and back, plus close-ups of corners.
Photo/video of a multimeter reading open-circuit voltage or current while panel is in sunlight.

risks.risk: Brand/manufacturer unverified — affects warranty value and price tier.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any brand nameplate, model number, or certification sticker.

risks.risk: Quantity unclear — seller's text implies a broader 'solar energy solution' business, but only one panel is shown; unclear if this is a single unit for sale or a sample image.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of exact quantity and photo of all units together.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the rear specification sticker showing rated wattage, voltage, and current.
Photo of any brand/model label or certification mark on the frame or junction box.
Straight-on, well-lit photos of front and back showing full panel without glare.
Photo or short video of a multimeter test showing voltage/current output in sunlight.
Confirmation of exact quantity being sold.
response.reason: The single photo shows a generic, unbranded solar panel with no readable wattage, spec sticker, or model — the key detail that sets its price tier is missing, so even a worst-case price cannot be assigned yet.
